sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: G.709 OTN：框架有效負載利用率
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學訊號需40 GHz完整通帶；4級模型可行、9級不足；只在高斯模型內作此結論。 filter_cascade.csv與逐級/總通帶曲線 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 50 與變更 33.3333 GHz、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching signal needs40 GHz passband:4 modeled stages suffice and9 do not; the conclusion is limited to the Gaussian model. filter_cascade.csv and individual/cascaded passbands Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 50 and changed 33.3333 GHz, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學服務要求88 Gbit/s；9000-bit負載達標，8500不足；不得由框架效率推斷延遲。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching service requires88 Gbit/s:9000-bit payload passes and8500 fails; efficiency does not establish latency.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成單級高斯功率3dB頻寬100 GHz；比較4與9級，頻率中心完全對齊。 名義式 100/sqrt(4) = 50 GHz；變更式 100/sqrt(9) = 33.3333 GHz。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 在等效半功率點逐級乘透射率確認總功率1/2；不要把振幅高斯和功率高斯混用。

合成每框10000 bits，其中負載9000；線速100 Gbit/s；變更負載8500而框長不變。 名義式 100*9000/10000 = 90 Gbit/s；變更式 100*8500/10000 = 85 Gbit/s。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 以一秒完整框數乘每框負載獨立驗算；明示忽略最後不完整框的連續近似。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic single-stage Gaussian power3 dB bandwidth100 GHz; compare4 and9 centered stages. Nominal 100/sqrt(4) = 50 GHz; changed 100/sqrt(9) = 33.3333 GHz. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Multiply stage power transmissions at the predicted half-power frequency and recover1/2; distinguish amplitude and power Gaussian definitions.

Synthetic10000-bit frame with9000 payload bits at100 Gbit/s; change payload to8500 with total frame size fixed. Nominal 100*9000/10000 = 90 Gbit/s; changed 100*8500/10000 = 85 Gbit/s. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Cross-check frames per second multiplied by payload bits and state the continuous approximation for the final partial frame.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 50G-PON：高線速不消除分光限制
related.titleEn: 50G-PON: high line rate does not remove split constraints
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學訊號需40 GHz完整通帶；4級模型可行、9級不足；只在高斯模型內作此結論。 filter_cascade.csv與逐級/總通帶曲線 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 50 與變更 33.3333 GHz、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching signal needs40 GHz passband:4 modeled stages suffice and9 do not; the conclusion is limited to the Gaussian model. filter_cascade.csv and individual/cascaded passbands Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 50 and changed 33.3333 GHz, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學最差裕度需非負；128分光不能因標示50G而被批准。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching worst-case margin must be nonnegative; a50G label does not approve128-way splitting.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成單級高斯功率3dB頻寬100 GHz；比較4與9級，頻率中心完全對齊。 名義式 100/sqrt(4) = 50 GHz；變更式 100/sqrt(9) = 33.3333 GHz。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 在等效半功率點逐級乘透射率確認總功率1/2；不要把振幅高斯和功率高斯混用。

合成可用光預算30 dB、纖路及接頭9 dB、超額2 dB；N=32改128。 名義式 30-9-2-10*log10(32) = 3.9485 dB；變更式 30-9-2-10*log10(128) = -2.0721 dB。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 將N加倍兩次，損耗應增加約6.0206 dB；與逐次1:2級聯獨立核對。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic single-stage Gaussian power3 dB bandwidth100 GHz; compare4 and9 centered stages. Nominal 100/sqrt(4) = 50 GHz; changed 100/sqrt(9) = 33.3333 GHz. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Multiply stage power transmissions at the predicted half-power frequency and recover1/2; distinguish amplitude and power Gaussian definitions.

Synthetic optical allowance30 dB, path/connectors9 dB and excess2 dB; changeN from32 to128. Nominal 30-9-2-10*log10(32) = 3.9485 dB; changed 30-9-2-10*log10(128) = -2.0721 dB. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Two doublings ofN should add about6.0206 dB loss; verify by cascading two1:2 splitters.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
